platform: WordPress + Hello Elementor theme + Elementor Pro (built 2024 by 75 Degrees West)
note: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Not design DNA. The owl template is the sole source of layout and structure.
strengths: Real project photography — roughly 45 unique in-house job photos in the gallery, not stock.
Genuine, specific review text naming the designer by name.
FAQ page publishes concrete lead times and payment terms — unusually transparent for the vertical.
Clear five-service structure (kitchens, bathrooms, cabinets, countertops, design services) with a real brand roster behind it.
PA HIC registration number displayed in the footer.
weaknesses: Phone number is not a persistent sticky CTA; on mobile the header collapses and the call action is easy to miss.
Bathrooms page carries copy-paste boilerplate from another company — it repeatedly refers to the 'Artisan design team' and 'Artisan's designers'. Live credibility bug.
No service-area pages at all — zero local SEO surface for Wilkes-Barre, Kingston, Mountain Top, Dallas, Nanticoke.
The best trust asset (published timelines, 75% deposit terms, since-1995 history) is buried on /faq and /about rather than surfaced on the home page.
Contact page is effectively empty — just an '## Contact' heading with the global form; no map, no showroom hours block, no directions.
Heavy image payload: full-resolution unoptimized JPEGs (several 'scaled' originals) hotlinked directly into galleries.
Third-party accessibility-toolbar plugin bolted on rather than accessible markup.
Hero is a generic slider with two slides ('Kitchen Remodeling' / 'Bathroom Remodeling') and no value proposition, no rating proof, no CTA above the fold on load.
Testimonials rendered as H2 headings for the reviewer names — bad heading semantics for SEO and screen readers.
No blog, no schema-rich local business markup surfaced, thin meta coverage on inner pages.
load_issues: Numerous multi-megabyte unresized uploads (e.g. *-scaled-1.jpg) served at full size.
reCAPTCHA v2 plus Elementor Pro plus an accessibility plugin all loading on every page.
